description:
A user, Michael Chang (michael.chang@acmecorp.com), contacted the IT Service Desk claiming he accidentally rated his recent support experience as '1 - Very Dissatisfied' when he meant '5 - Very Satisfied'. As the survey administrator, you need to correct this data.

1. Log in to the LimeSurvey admin panel (http://localhost/index.php/admin) with credentials `admin` / `Admin123!`.
2. Navigate to the active survey 'IT Service Desk Satisfaction 2025'.
3. Locate the response for 'michael.chang@acmecorp.com' in the Responses menu.
4. Edit the response to change the 'Overall Satisfaction' answer from '1 - Very Dissatisfied' to '5 - Very Satisfied'.
5. Add the text '[Admin correction: Updated per ticket #8842]' to the 'Additional Comments' field (keep existing text if any).
6. Save the changes.
